body.cap: Peter Wonsok Yun, Commissioner of the Incheon Free Economic Zone Authority (IFEZ), and representatives from participating companies pose for a group photo at the 'INCHEON-IFEZ' Pavilion, located in the AI Zone of the North Hall at the Las Vegas Convention Center, on January 7 (local time). | Photo courtesy of IFEZ

body.x: The Incheon Free Economic Zone Authority (IFEZ), led by Commissioner Peter Wonsok Yun, announced the opening of the 'INCHEON-IFEZ' Pavilion at CES 2025 in Las Vegas on January 7 (local time).

The pavilion, which covers 139 square meters in the AI Zone of the North Hall at the Las Vegas Convention Center, symbolizes Incheon’s global connectivity. It is inspired by landmarks such as the Incheon Bridge and Incheon International Airport.

Under the theme "Urban Renaissance: Building Tomorrow's Smart Cities Today," the pavilion comprises four themed zones: Health & Safety, Urban Intelligence, Eco Harmony, and X-Tech. These zones demonstrate the convergence of technology, nature, and humanity, offering visitors an immersive experience of sustainable urban futures.
The pavilion also hosted the "Unveiled Incheon Media Stage,” which over thirty major international media outlets attended.

In a video message, Yoo Jeong-bok, Mayor of Incheon, emphasized, “Incheon is creating a sustainable city where technology, people, and the environment harmonize, based on global collaboration. Our city is becoming a hub for international cooperation, offering an ideal environment for global companies and institutions to thrive.”

body.cap: Peter Wonsok Yun, Commissioner of IFEZ, delivers a presentation outlining the vision for Incheon’s smart city development at the 'INCHEON-IFEZ' Pavilion in the AI Zone of the North Hall at the Las Vegas Convention Center on January 7 (local time). | Photo courtesy of IFEZ

body.x: During his presentation, Commissioner Peter Wonsok Yun shared IFEZ’s future vision, highlighting smart city services, innovative startup support, and the development of a biotech cluster. He stated, “By sharing IFEZ’s unique smart city model, fostering innovative startups, and building a bio cluster, IFEZ aims to establish itself as a global leader in smart cities.”
Beyond the exhibition, IFEZ organized various networking events during CES 2025 to enhance global smart city leadership and expand business collaborations.

On the evening of January 7 (local time), the "All Connected Incheon Night" event provided a platform for Incheon’s innovative startups, global companies, and urban leaders to explore collaborative opportunities. On January 8, presentations featuring LG Electronics, Lotte Innovate, and the Korea Stanford Center shared insights into IFEZ’s smart city expertise. On January 9, IFEZ will host an event inviting over 30 global investors to showcase the innovative technologies of Incheon startups and foster new partnerships.

AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, continues to bridge the gap for Korean SMEs and startups looking to expand globally. To promote Korean startups worldwide, AVING will host its Broadcasting Zone at the Venetian Expo, featuring the CES Media Day Startup Conference and global media interviews. AVING’s international media partners will cover these programs.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host review conferences with participating companies in Korea, offering a platform for increased visibility and improved corporate image.
